name: proposed_relation
description: The relation-type key of the link a suggestion comment proposes.

aiGuidance.purpose: Set only on a suggestion comment that proposes a link: the installed relation-type key (for example com.semanticops.method/answers) of the link from the commented record to the record the comment proposes-link-to. The link itself is not written until it is affirmed: a relation is a claim and has no suggested state (remedy 2910ac1e). The owner answers with an agree or disagree response.
